We owe illegal immigrants nothing.

We owe our veterans everything.

We won’t sit back while Jewish Americans are getting attacked in our own country and wait for the next tragedy.

We introduced the No Amnesty for Hamas Sympathizers Act, cutting off all immigration benefits and legal protections for individuals from Palestinian-controlled areas or those holding Palestinian Authority travel documents.

This should never happen in America. This bill slams the door shut and keeps terrorist sympathizers and antisemitic extremists out.

When we questioned former President Bill Clinton, his lawyer barely let him answer a single question.

So the question stands: do you think a young girl massaging a president is unusual? We sure do.

We will not stop until there is accountability and justice for every victim of Jeffrey Epstein.

PASS THE SAVE AMERICA ACT.


The White House (@WhiteHouse)

South Carolina is not Big Tech's personal power grid.

We're calling for a one-year moratorium on new data center construction in South Carolina, putting Big Tech on notice: South Carolina families will not foot the bill for their massive energy demands.

These companies are planting massive data centers across our state, driving up energy demand, and leaving families and small businesses to pick up the tab. South Carolinians are already stretched thin. The last thing they need is a higher elect

Summerville is one of the fastest growing communities in South Carolina and public safety must keep pace.

When local leaders made it clear more officers were needed, we got to work. We helped secure $625,000 for the Town of Summerville Police Department through the U.S. Department of Justice's COPS Office Hiring Program, funding the addition of five new police officers to strengthen public safety in the community.

Keeping our communities safe is non-negotiable and it starts with making sure la

There are two very different approaches to public safety in America today. One coddles criminals. The other stands shoulder-to-shoulder with the men and women who show up to stop them.

We have never been confused about where we stand, and neither have the people of South Carolina.

Safe communities are not built by politicians playing games with public safety or pushing soft-on-crime policies. They are built by officers who run toward danger without hesitation, and leaders who back them up the

MACE WIN: Over $40 million returned to constituents in South Carolina.

Social Security, the IRS, VA benefits. Nancy Mace works to get back every dollar constituents are owed. These agencies answer to the people, and when they fail to deliver, Nancy Mace steps in and makes sure they do.

South Carolinians should never have to beg for money they earned. They never will on my watch. Your money belongs in your wallet, not in Washington.

South Carolina STRONG.

We have been delivering for our seniors.

Social Security is not a government handout. It is a promise. Our seniors paid into it dollar by dollar, year by year, their entire working lives.

Rep. Mace championed provisions in the One Big Beautiful Bill Act to make sure Washington keeps it. The OBBB delivers a new $6,000 tax deduction for seniors, $12,000 for married couples, so 88% of Social Security recipients will pay zero federal income taxes on their benefits. Our office attended the arrival celebration for Sea Eagle Market's newest shrimp boat.

A huge accomplishment for the family and the shrimping industry of the Lowcountry. Congratulations on the new boat. We cannot wait for more fresh shrimp caught right here in South Carolina.

South Carolina STRONG.

Veterans in rural South Carolina should not have to drive hours just to access VA healthcare. Senior veterans should not be forced to navigate a broken system alone. Female veterans should not be receiving care from providers with little to no training in their specific needs.

These are not hypothetical problems. This is the reality too many veterans face every single day, and we are doing something about it.

South Carolina STRONG.

WEEKLY LEGISLATIVE UPDATE FROM WASHINGTON

NATIONAL POLICE WEEK: BACKING THE BLUE
The House passed a number of resolutions recognizing law enforcement and measures aimed at reducing crime, right on time for National Police Week.

NEW LEGISLATION:
We introduced H.R. 8821, the No Bailouts for Cashless Bail Jurisdictions Act.

A full year of ZERO illegal immigrants released at our southern border.

The most secure border in American history is not a talking point. It is a measurable, undeniable reality built by an administration with the backbone to enforce the law.

This is what leadership looks like. This is what happens when an administration means what it says.

We stood with President Trump on border security from day one. Promises made, promises kept.

Our office attended Radiance Pregnancy Care Center's open house in Beaufort to learn about their nonprofit and the work they are doing to support women at every stage of pregnancy.

The Radiance Pregnancy Care Center is celebrating 40 years of educating women across the Lowcountry and sharing the gospel with soon-to-be moms to uplift them in faith throughout their pregnancy journeys.

South Carolina STRONG.

South Carolina's shrimping industry is a way of life. They are the backbone of our coastal economy, which is why we work so hard to make sure South Carolina shrimpers have a seat at the table in Washington.
